metadata.date_added_semantics: date the company first entered the tracker (legacy snapshot dates preserved); entries dated 2026-09-07 were added in the September 2026 rebuild
metadata.last_updated_semantics: date any field was last changed
metadata.last_verified_semantics: date facts were last checked against cited sources
verification_status_values: partial = single-source or estimate flagged in notes

startups.about: Inference infrastructure for serving frontier and custom models
startups.description: Baseten provides production inference infrastructure for frontier labs and enterprises, serving models like DeepSeek-R1 and custom checkpoints at scale. It raised a $1.5B Series F at a $13B valuation in June 2026, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction, and Spark Capital — its fourth fundraise in 18 months with 20x growth.

startups.about: Data-centric AI: automated data quality and error correction
startups.description: Cleanlab, founded by MIT PhD Curtis Northcutt, provides automated data-quality tooling that detects and fixes label errors to improve model reliability for enterprises. It raised $25M in Series A funding led by Menlo Ventures and TQ Ventures, bringing total funding to ~$30M from Menlo, TQ, Bain Capital Ventures, and Databricks Ventures.
startups.notes: Series A closed Sep 2024; no newer round found as of Sep 2026.

startups.about: AI factory company: energy-first data centers for model training
startups.description: Crusoe builds AI-dedicated data centers powered by stranded and clean energy, operating large GPU clusters for lab customers. It raised over $3B at a ~$30B valuation in September 2026 from Atreides, Valor Equity, and Mubadala — tripling its valuation in ten months — after a $13B data-center contract with Jane Street was reported.

startups.about: Data & AI platform: lakehouse, Unity Catalog, and agent tooling
startups.description: Databricks operates the leading lakehouse data-and-AI platform used by over 15,000 enterprises. It closed a ~$5B round at a $134B valuation in late 2025 and then a new round at a $188B valuation in August 2026 led by Coatue, with revenue run-rate exceeding $5.4B and 65% year-over-year growth.
startups.source: Cryptobriefing via filings, SeedTable, Chopping Block
startups.notes: Aug 2026 round at $188B per multiple secondary reports; official PR pending.

startups.about: AI data centers as flexible power-grid assets
startups.description: Emerald AI builds orchestration software that turns AI data centers into flexible grid resources, shifting GPU workloads to protect power grids during stress. It raised a $150M Series A at a $1.05B valuation in August 2026 — becoming a unicorn — bringing total funding to $220M+ from investors including NVentures (Nvidia) and Radical Ventures.

startups.about: Data engine for multimodal AI model development
startups.description: Encord provides an end-to-end data engine for curating, annotating, and evaluating multimodal training data across vision, medical imaging, and documents. It raised a $60M Series C led by Wellington Management in February 2026, bringing total funding to ~$90M as it scales AI-native data infrastructure.
startups.notes: Valuation estimate not officially disclosed.

startups.about: Generative media inference cloud (image, video, audio models)
startups.description: fal runs an ultra-low-latency inference cloud for generative media models, powering image and video creation for thousands of apps. It raised a $140M Series D at a $4.5B valuation in December 2025 with Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, and Nvidia joining, then discussed a $300–350M round at ~$8B in March 2026 as revenue doubled to $400M.

startups.about: Inference platform for fast, production-grade open models
startups.description: Fireworks AI provides low-latency inference and fine-tuning for open and custom models at production scale. It closed a $1.505B Series D at a $17.5B valuation in July 2026 — led by Atreides Management, Index Ventures, and others — alongside announcing $1B in ARR, up from a $4B valuation in mid-2025.

startups.about: Enterprise AI search and work assistant platform
startups.description: Glean provides AI-powered enterprise search and an assistant grounded in company knowledge across all workplace apps. Its $150M Series F at a $7.2B valuation (June 2025) remains its latest priced round; ARR crossed $300M by May 2026 as budget pressure on AI spend became its selling point. OpenAI's competing enterprise offerings have intensified pressure on the category.

startups.about: LPU inference hardware and fast AI inference cloud
startups.description: Groq pioneered the LPU deterministic inference architecture and now operates a fast-growing AI inference cloud. After Nvidia's ~$20B licensing deal removed its chipmaking talent, Groq raised $650M in June 2026 and another $350M in August 2026 at a $3.5B valuation — roughly half its prior mark — as it pivots to a neocloud model on Nvidia hardware.
startups.notes: Nvidia $20B licensing deal (late 2025) reshaped the company's trajectory.

startups.about: AI search & analysis engine for finance and professional services
startups.description: Hebbia applies LLM agents to complex document analysis for private equity, hedge funds, and law firms via its Matrix product. It raised a $130M Series B at a ~$700M valuation in July 2024 led by a16z with Index Ventures, GV, and Peter Thiel participating, and has grown materially since without a newer priced round.

startups.about: Open-source AI hub: models, datasets, and collaboration platform
startups.description: Hugging Face hosts the world's largest open-model ecosystem — millions of models and datasets — plus enterprise tooling for AI builders. Its last primary round was $235M at a $4.5B valuation in August 2023; Business Insider reported in January 2026 that the company had drawn acquisition interest at $13B+. The platform remains critical infrastructure for open-weight AI.
startups.source: Reuters, Business Insider via TechCrunch, Tracxn
startups.notes: No primary round since Aug 2023; secondary market implies materially higher valuation.

startups.about: GPU cloud for AI training and inference (Superintelligence Cloud)
startups.description: Lambda provides GPU clouds and on-prem supercomputers purpose-built for AI workloads. It raised over $1.5B in Series E funding led by TWG Global in November 2025, then a $1B private debt facility in August 2026 to buy Nvidia chips leased to Microsoft. Total equity funding is ~$2.4B.
startups.notes: Valuation reports conflict ($2.5B–$6.9B); using ~$4B midpoint estimate.

startups.about: AI-moderated customer research and voice interviews at scale
startups.description: Listen Labs runs thousands of simultaneous AI-moderated voice and video interviews, synthesizing customer insights automatically for brands. It raised a $69M Series B led by Ribbit Capital in January 2026, bringing total funding to $100M alongside Sequoia Capital and Conviction.
startups.notes: Valuation estimate unconfirmed; round size and leads confirmed by company.

startups.about: Open platform for evaluating AI models via human preference
startups.description: LMArena, spun out of UC Berkeley's Chatbot Arena, benchmarks frontier models through millions of real human preference votes. It raised a $150M Series A at a $1.7B post-money valuation in January 2026, led by Felicis and UC Investments, tripling its valuation in eight months and becoming a unicorn ~7 months after launch.

startups.about: AI training data & expert talent marketplace for frontier labs
startups.description: Mercor recruits domain experts and structures their expertise into training data for frontier AI labs, powering RLHF and evaluation pipelines. It raised a $350M Series C at a $10B valuation in October 2025 and announced the acquisition of data-engine startup Deeptune. Talks for a $500M round at ~$20B led by General Catalyst were reported in July–August 2026.
startups.notes: Aug 2026: $20B round led by General Catalyst reportedly in discussions.

startups.about: Data engine for AI: labeling, evaluation, and agent data
startups.description: Scale AI provides data labeling, evaluation, and model-engineering services to enterprises and governments. Meta acquired 49% for ~$14.3B at a $29B valuation in June 2025, with ex-CEO Alexandr Wang joining Meta; under new CEO Jason Droege, Scale says sales have rebounded and it expects to top $1B revenue in 2026.
startups.status_note: Meta purchased 49% for ~$14.3B (Jun 2025); company remains independently operated.

startups.about: Human data labeling and RLHF for frontier model training
startups.description: Surge AI supplies high-quality human data and RLHF pipelines to frontier labs and enterprises, bootstrapping to ~$1.2B revenue in 2024 with zero outside capital. It initiated its first external fundraise in July 2025 — seeking up to $1B at a valuation reportedly exceeding $15B — with the round's final terms still not formally disclosed as of September 2026.
startups.notes: Round sought and valuation range widely reported; closure not confirmed.

startups.about: Open-model cloud: inference, fine-tuning, and GPU clusters
startups.description: Together AI runs a cloud platform for open and custom models — serving, fine-tuning, and dedicated Nvidia GPU capacity. It raised an $800M Series C at an $8.3B post-money valuation on July 1, 2026, led by Aramco Ventures, more than doubling its valuation as it scales the production platform for open-source AI.

startups.about: AI developer platform for experiment tracking and model management; acquired by CoreWeave
startups.description: Weights & Biases (W&B) provided the standard developer platform for ML experiment tracking, datasets, and model evaluation, used by most major AI labs. CoreWeave completed its ~$1.7B acquisition on May 5, 2025, keeping W&B's products available across clouds. Its last priced round was a $250M total raise at a $1.25B valuation (2023).

startups.about: AI safety company building the Claude family of LLMs
startups.description: Anthropic develops the Claude LLM family with a safety-first research agenda and enterprise API business. It raised $65B at a $965B post-money valuation in May 2026, surpassing OpenAI as the world's most valuable startup. WSJ reports the company is tracking toward ~$50B in annualized revenue, with IPO preparations reportedly targeting mid-October 2026.

startups.about: Image & video generation models (FLUX family)
startups.description: Black Forest Labs, founded by original Stable Diffusion researchers in Freiburg, develops the FLUX family of image and video generation models. It closed a $300M Series B at a $3.25B post-money valuation in December 2025, bringing total funding to ~$450M. Annualized revenue was reported near $96M in late 2025.

startups.about: Secure enterprise LLMs, RAG, and sovereign AI
startups.description: Cohere provides enterprise-grade LLMs and retrieval-augmented generation with deployment options for regulated industries and sovereign AI programs. It raised a $500M round at a $6.8B valuation in August 2025, followed by a $100M second close in September bringing the round to $600M at roughly $7B. Revenue closed 2025 at ~$240M ARR with IPO speculation building through 2026.

startups.about: AI voice synthesis, dubbing, and conversational audio
startups.description: ElevenLabs is the leading AI audio platform for voice cloning, dubbing, and conversational agents across 30+ languages. It raised $500M at an $11B valuation in February 2026 — led by Sequoia and more than tripling its January 2025 valuation of $3.3B — and is weighing an IPO. A secondary tender at a reported $22B valuation was in early talks in July 2026.

startups.about: Bootstrapped AI image generation studio
startups.description: Midjourney produces state-of-the-art AI image generation, distributed via Discord and web app, and has never raised external equity funding. It generated ~$200M ARR as early as 2023 and remains fully founder-owned, so it carries no priced valuation or funding round.
startups.notes: Included as a notable exception: no funding round by design.

startups.about: Europe's leading open-weight foundation model lab
startups.description: Mistral AI trains open-weight and commercial LLMs and is Europe's flagship AI lab. Its Series C closed at €1.7B (~$2.0B) with an €11.7B (~$13.8B) post-money valuation in September 2025, with ASML participating. Talks for a ~€3B round at ~€20B valuation were reported in June 2026 but not confirmed closed.
startups.notes: €3B round at ~€20B valuation reported in talks (Jun 2026); not confirmed closed.

startups.about: Frontier AI research & deployment — GPT models, ChatGPT, and agentic products
startups.description: OpenAI builds the GPT family of frontier models, the ChatGPT assistant, and agentic developer tooling. It closed a $122B committed-capital round at an $852B post-money valuation on March 31, 2026, the largest private raise on record. Annualized revenue passed $25B in early 2026.
startups.notes: Surpassed only by Anthropic's $965B valuation in May 2026.

startups.about: AI-powered answer engine and Comet browser
startups.description: Perplexity operates an AI answer engine combining search with cited LLM responses, plus the Comet agentic browser. Its Series E-6 round in January 2026 valued the company at ~$22.6B, with total funding of ~$1.7B across 11 rounds. ARR grew from ~$200M (Sep 2025) to a reported $750M+ by August 2026, with a public listing targeted for 2028.

startups.about: Frontier AI models for software engineering
startups.description: Poolside trains frontier reasoning models for software engineering, applying reinforcement learning on code execution traces. In August 2026 it struck a $6B licensing deal with Nvidia and raised $1B at a $12B valuation for the remaining company. This followed a ~$2B raise announced in October 2025 that included a $500M–$1B Nvidia investment.

startups.about: Generative video models and creative AI tools (Gen-4)
startups.description: Runway builds state-of-the-art video generation models and creative tooling used across film, advertising, and media production. It raised a $315M Series E in February 2026, nearly doubling its valuation to $5.3B from $3.3B at its $308M Series D in April 2025. Total funding now exceeds $860M.

startups.about: Ilya Sutskever's lab dedicated solely to safe superintelligence
startups.description: SSI is a research lab co-founded by former OpenAI chief scientist Ilya Sutskever, pursuing superintelligence with a deliberate no-product strategy. It raised $2B at a $32B valuation in April 2025, following a $1B debut at $5B in September 2024. Nvidia entered a research partnership with the lab in July 2026.

startups.about: Generative AI music platform
startups.description: Suno lets anyone create full songs — vocals, lyrics, and instrumentals — from text prompts, and has become the leading consumer AI music platform. It raised over $400M in Series D funding at a $5.4B post-money valuation in June 2026, led by Bond Capital with IVP participating, up from a $2.45B valuation in November 2025 on ~$200M revenue.

startups.about: AI video avatars & enterprise video creation platform
startups.description: Synthesia is the leading enterprise AI video platform, generating presenter-led videos from text with lifelike avatars in 140+ languages for training, sales, and communications. It closed a $200M Series E at a $4B valuation in January 2026, led by GV — nearly doubling its $2.1B valuation from January 2025.

startups.about: Mira Murati's AI lab; builds Tinker fine-tuning API
startups.description: Thinking Machines Lab is a frontier AI lab founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati. It raised a record $2B seed at a $12B valuation with participation from Nvidia, AMD, Cisco, and Jane Street, and released Tinker, an API for fine-tuning open models. The Information reported talks for a $1B round at roughly a $40B valuation in September 2026 after a larger round collapsed.
startups.notes: Talks for $1B at ~$40B pre-money reported Sep 3, 2026 (Accel leading, Nvidia considering).

startups.about: Builds Grok LLMs and the Colossus supercomputer
startups.description: xAI develops the Grok model series and operates the Colossus GPU supercomputer in Memphis. It completed an upsized $20B Series E in January 2026 — exceeding its $15B target — at roughly a $230B post-money valuation. Secondary-market reports of a SpaceX-xAI transaction remain unconfirmed.
startups.notes: Unconfirmed secondary-market reports of SpaceX merger at ~$250B (Feb 2026).

startups.about: AI-powered go-to-market & sales automation platform
startups.description: Clay aggregates 100+ data providers and uses AI research agents to automate prospecting and outbound for GTM teams. It raised a $100M Series C at a $3.1B valuation in August 2025, led by CapitalG — more than doubling its valuation — with total funding of $277M+ and headcount above 1,400 by mid-2026.

startups.about: Devin — the autonomous AI software engineer; owns Windsurf
startups.description: Cognition builds Devin, the AI software engineer that plans and executes multi-step engineering work, and acquired code-editor Windsurf in 2025. It raised $1B at a $26B valuation in May 2026 — more than doubling in eight months — with $492M ARR. In August 2026 Bloomberg reported talks for a new round that could value the company at $40B+.
startups.notes: Aug 2026: reported talks at $40B+ valuation (Bloomberg).

startups.about: Enterprise AI agents for customer support
startups.description: Decagon deploys AI support agents that resolve complex customer tickets across chat, email, and voice for enterprises including Notion and Substack. It raised a $250M Series D at a $4.5B valuation in January 2026, led by Coatue and Index Ventures — tripling its $1.5B valuation from June 2025 — with total funding above $500M.

startups.about: AI platform for law firms and professional services
startups.description: Harvey builds domain-tuned AI for legal research, drafting, and workflow automation, used by top law firms and in-house teams. It raised $200M at an $11B valuation in March 2026 (GIC and Sequoia leading), months after an $8B round in December 2025, and passed $350M ARR. The Information reported talks to raise $500M at $15.5B in August 2026.
startups.notes: Aug 2026: reported talks at $15.5B valuation (The Information).

startups.about: Invite-only personal AI assistant startup
startups.description: Instinct is building a general-purpose personal AI assistant, founded by 23-year-old Noah Shinn, operating invite-only while scaling. It raised a $250M Series B at a $2.5B valuation in August 2026, co-led by Index Ventures and Benchmark, making it one of the fastest seed-to-Series-B jumps of the year.
startups.notes: Round terms reported by WSJ (Aug 26, 2026); company blog confirmation pending.

startups.about: Platform for building, deploying, and observing AI agents
startups.description: LangChain provides the leading open-source framework for LLM application development plus LangSmith for observability and LangGraph for agent orchestration. It raised $125M at a $1.25B valuation in October 2025, led by IVP with Sequoia participating, positioning itself as the platform for agent engineering.

startups.about: Collaborative AI for legal work (formerly Leya)
startups.description: Legora builds a collaborative AI workspace for lawyers — research, drafting, and contract analysis — adopted by firms across 25+ markets. It completed a $550M Series D at a $5.5B valuation in March 2026 led by Accel, then a $50M extension in April taking the round to $600M at $5.6B — tripling its October 2025 valuation.

startups.about: Agentic AI platform for enterprise customer experience
startups.description: Sierra, co-founded by OpenAI chairman Bret Taylor, builds autonomous AI agents that handle customer service end-to-end for enterprises like SiriusXM and Sonos. It raised a $950M round at a $15.8B post-money valuation in May 2026, led by Tiger Global and GV — up from $10B in late 2025.

startups.about: AI-native project management for software teams
startups.description: Blossom is an AI-native project management tool for software teams from Berlin, predicting risks and automating sprint planning. Its verifiable funding remains a $2M seed (2022); earlier higher figures in this tracker could not be corroborated and have been corrected.
startups.notes: Original repo claimed 'Series A $22M' — unsupported; corrected to seed.

startups.about: Precision AI search and agentic research for law firms
startups.description: DeepJudge provides AI-powered enterprise search and multi-step agentic research over a law firm's own knowledge base. It raised a $41.2M Series A led by Felicis in November 2025 — roughly double earlier reported figures — to scale adoption across US and UK legal markets.

startups.about: Agentic procurement and supplier management platform
startups.description: Omnea provides AI-powered procurement — intake, sourcing, and supplier risk — marketed as the agentic operating system for procurement. It raised a $50M Series B led by Insight Partners and Khosla Ventures in September 2025, up from a $25M Series A in 2024.

startups.about: AI growth platform for independent restaurants
startups.description: Owner provides an AI-powered operating platform for local restaurants — websites, ordering, marketing, and retention — competing with DoorDash-owned tooling. It raised $240M at a $2.3B valuation in August 2026, led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives' growth equity, with $100M+ ARR.

startups.about: Swipe-based job search where AI agents apply on your behalf (YC)
startups.description: Sorce is a Tinder-style job search app where swiping right triggers an AI agent that applies to the role on the company's site; it has indexed 4M+ jobs and submitted 1M+ applications. The YC-backed startup secured ~$500K in early funding in 2026.

startups.about: Cursor — the AI-native code editor and coding agent
startups.description: Anysphere builds Cursor, the AI-native code editor and agent platform that became the fastest software company to scale revenue — from ~$100M to $2B+ annualized between late 2025 and early 2026. Its $2.3B Series D at a $29.3B valuation (Nov 2025) was followed in June 2026 by SpaceX's agreement to acquire the company for $60B in an all-stock deal, expected to close in Q3 2026.
startups.status_note: SpaceX agreed to acquire Anysphere for $60B in stock (announced Jun 16, 2026; expected close Q3 2026).

startups.about: Real-time analytics database powering AI and observability workloads
startups.description: ClickHouse develops the namesake open-source columnar database for real-time analytics at extreme scale, adopted across AI and observability stacks. It raised $400M at a $15B valuation in January 2026, led by Dragoneer with Bessemer, GIC, Index, and Khosla participating — up sharply from its $6B mid-2025 round.

startups.about: AI app builder that turns prompts into full-stack products
startups.description: Lovable is Europe's fastest-growing AI app builder, generating full-stack web applications from natural-language prompts. It raised a $400M Series C at a $13.3B valuation in August 2026, led by Menlo Ventures with EQT's Scaleup Europe Fund co-leading — double its December 2025 valuation of $6.6B. Total funding is ~$1.05B.

startups.about: AI mobile app development platform (AndroidWorld record holder)
startups.description: Minitap accelerates mobile feature development with AI, cutting launch times from six weeks to days, and topped DeepMind's AndroidWorld benchmark. The Paris-based startup raised a €3.5M (~$4.1M) seed co-led by Moxxie Ventures and Mercuri in December 2025.

startups.about: AI-powered end-to-end testing for web applications
startups.description: Momentic automates end-to-end web testing with AI agents that write, heal, and maintain tests without brittle selectors. It raised a $15M Series A led by Standard Capital with Dropbox Ventures participating; total funding is ~$19.2M.

startups.about: Unified API gateway routing traffic across 400+ AI models
startups.description: OpenRouter provides a single API that routes application traffic across 400+ models from all major labs with automatic failover and price optimization. Stripe agreed to acquire the company for $7.5B in August 2026 — roughly three years after its 2023 founding — to embed model routing into its AI-era payments stack.
startups.status_note: Stripe acquisition for $7.5B announced Aug 19, 2026 (NYT-sourced price).

startups.about: Cloud IDE and agentic platform for building software (Replit Agent)
startups.description: Replit lets anyone build and deploy software from the browser, with its AI Agent generating complete applications from natural language. It raised a $400M Series D at a $9B valuation in March 2026, led by Georgian with a16z and Qatar Investment Authority — tripling from $3B six months earlier as ARR jumped from $2.8M to ~$150M in under a year.

startups.about: AI builder that creates complete mobile apps from prompts (YC)
startups.description: Rork generates and publishes complete React Native mobile apps from natural-language prompts, one of the notable AI app builders from YC's 2025 batches. No credible institutional round has been confirmed as of September 2026; funding figures from the original tracker could not be verified.
startups.notes: Company verified to exist; funding unverified.

startups.about: bolt.new — AI web app builder running dev environments in the browser
startups.description: StackBlitz created bolt.new, an AI app builder that generates, runs, and deploys full-stack web apps in-browser via WebContainers. It raised a $105.5M Series B at a ~$700M valuation (Jan 2025), with total funding of ~$135M, and was reportedly in discussions to raise at a materially higher valuation through 2026 amid extreme traffic growth.

startups.about: Unified API connecting AI agents to enterprise SaaS and HR systems
startups.description: StackOne provides a unified integration layer that lets AI agents and SaaS products connect securely with enterprise systems like HRIS and ATS platforms. It has raised $24.4M across 3 rounds since 2023, most recently a Series A, as agentic integration demand accelerates.

startups.about: Open-source Postgres backend-as-a-service, the AI app database
startups.description: Supabase provides an open-source Firebase alternative built on Postgres — auth, storage, realtime, vectors — and has become the default backend for AI-generated apps. It raised a $500M Series F at a $10.5B post-money valuation in June 2026, led by GIC, doubling its valuation in eight months with ~10M registered developers.

startups.about: Frontend cloud for Next.js and AI-native web apps (v0)
startups.description: Vercel operates the leading frontend cloud for Next.js and runs v0, its generative UI/app builder. It closed a $300M Series F at a $9.3B post-money valuation in September–November 2025, co-led by Accel and GIC, up from a $3.25B Series E in 2024.

startups.about: Climate-focused banking that funds clean energy via deposits
startups.description: Atmos Financial channels deposits into solar loans, battery storage, heat pumps, and EV charging financing as a public benefit corporation. It has raised $23M across 5 rounds, most recently a $13M Series A in November 2022, and continues scaling clean-economy lending as a niche climate-fintech.
startups.notes: No funding since Nov 2022; verified as operating as of Sep 2026.

startups.about: AI-powered fintech for startups; acquired by Capital One
startups.description: Brex offered corporate cards, banking, and AI expense automation for startups and SMBs, reaching a $12.3B peak valuation in 2021. Capital One announced its acquisition for $5.15B in cash and stock on January 23, 2026 — below peak but a landmark consolidation of startup banking.
startups.status_note: Capital One announced $5.15B acquisition on January 23, 2026.
startups.source: Crunchbase News, Capital One IR, LinkedIn analysis

startups.about: AI insurance verification and payer-policy automation for healthcare
startups.description: Harmonic automates insurance verification and payer-policy workflows for dental and medical providers using AI. It has raised $295M across 3 rounds, most recently a $120M Series C in November 2025, as it expands AI revenue-cycle automation for care organizations.
startups.notes: Original repo listed it as 'Harmonic — project management, Series A $18M' — corrected.

startups.about: AI-powered renters, homeowners & pet insurance; NYSE-listed
startups.description: Lemonade uses AI chatbots (Maya, Jim) to quote, underwrite, and process claims for renters, homeowners, car, and pet insurance. Publicly traded on NYSE (LMND) since July 2020 after raising ~$800M privately — included as a public-company reference for AI-native insurance tracking.
startups.status_note: Publicly traded on NYSE (LMND) since July 2020.
startups.source: Startup Nation Finder, Yahoo Finance, Lemonade IR

startups.about: PCI-compliant payments infrastructure for voice AI agents
startups.description: Maven builds payments infrastructure that lets voice AI agents collect card payments securely during live calls via a single API. It raised a $9.5M seed in January 2026 from Quiet Capital, Slow Ventures, and Moxxie, and is part of Y Combinator's W26 batch, consistently doubling revenue.
startups.notes: No independent website confirmed as of Sep 2026; YC page used as canonical link.

startups.about: Banking and financial stack for startups and SMBs
startups.description: Mercury provides banking, credit cards, and Treasury for startups, scaling to 200K+ customers. It raised a $200M Series D at a $5.2B valuation in May 2026, led by TCV — up 49% in 14 months — as applications jumped 2.5x year-over-year.

startups.about: Financial data network connecting apps to 12,000+ banks
startups.description: Plaid operates the leading financial data network powering payments, lending, and fintech apps, connecting to 12,000+ institutions. It secured an $8B valuation in a February 2026 round and employee share sale, up 31% from $6.1B in April 2025, with a long-anticipated IPO reportedly on deck.

startups.about: AI-powered corporate cards, spend management, and procurement
startups.description: Ramp provides corporate cards and AI-driven spend management that automates expense workflows and finds savings. It raised $750M at a $44B valuation on June 4, 2026 — led by ICONIQ, GIC, and Ontario Teachers' — up from $32B in November 2025, after surpassing $1B in annualized revenue.

startups.about: Payments and programmable financial infrastructure for the internet
startups.description: Stripe is the private fintech giant powering internet payments, now near $2T in total volume processed. A February 2026 employee tender offer valued it at $159B — a 70%+ jump — led by Thrive, Coatue, and a16z, and it agreed in August 2026 to acquire AI model gateway OpenRouter for $7.5B as it builds the transaction layer for AI agents.
startups.status_note: IPO widely anticipated; last primary round $6.5B Series I at $50B (2023).

startups.about: AI clinical documentation and care intelligence from conversations
startups.description: Abridge converts clinician-patient conversations into structured medical notes and revenue-cycle data, deployed at health systems including Epic-integrated UPMC. It raised a $300M Series E at a $5.3B valuation led by a16z in June 2025, reaffirmed by a $316M Series E extension; total funding is ~$773M with ~2,000 employees.

startups.about: AI sales and customer-service agents for home services
startups.description: Avoca provides AI agents that answer, qualify, and book jobs for HVAC, plumbing, and home-service companies, and was among the fastest-scaling vertical AI startups. It has raised $125M across 3 rounds from Meritech, General Catalyst, Kleiner Perkins, and Y Combinator, with a 2026 round and $1B in booked jobs on track.
startups.notes: Original repo categorized as HealthTech with SF HQ — corrected (NYC; vertical AI for home services).

startups.about: AI employees for primary care practices (YC W26)
startups.description: Beacon Health builds AI agents that work inside any EHR like a human employee, doubling revenue for primary care practices while reducing total cost of care. It emerged from Y Combinator's W26 batch with ~$5.4M in early funding from YC and primary-care physicians.

startups.about: Safety-focused AI agents for patient-facing healthcare tasks
startups.description: Hippocratic AI builds voice AI agents for non-diagnostic patient tasks — pre-op prep, follow-ups, medication reminders — with an emphasis on safety certification. It raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation in November 2025, led by Avenir Growth, after a $141M Series B at $1.64B in January 2025.

startups.about: AI-powered primary care combining data and telehealth
startups.description: K Health provides AI-driven primary care — symptom assessment plus clinician-backed telehealth — using anonymized health records for triage. Its most recent major round was ~$50M in July 2024 led by Claure Group; total funding across 13 rounds is ~$439M.
startups.notes: Original repo listed 'Series E $132M' — corrected per primary reporting.

startups.about: AI medical knowledge platform used by 40% of US physicians
startups.description: OpenEvidence provides an AI-powered evidence search and clinical decision platform that became the fastest-adopted physician tool in history, free for verified clinicians and monetized via pharma advertising. It closed a $250M Series D at a $12B valuation in January 2026, with annualized revenue hitting $300M and reports of a raise at $20B in July 2026.
startups.source: Becker's Hospital Review, mobihealthnews, PR Newswire
startups.notes: Jul 2026: reportedly weighed $200M raise at $20B (The Information).

startups.about: AI care-coordination and disease-detection platform for hospitals
startups.description: Viz.ai detects strokes and other acute conditions from medical imaging and coordinates care teams in real time across 1,600+ hospitals. Its last priced round was a $100M Series D at a $1.2B valuation in April 2022; total funding is ~$252M across seven rounds.

startups.about: Humanoid robots for home and industry (EVE, NEO)
startups.description: 1X Technologies, an OpenAI-backed Norwegian-American robotics company, builds androids for home and industrial use and launched the NEO home humanoid. It raised roughly $650M across rounds in late 2025 and March 2026 at a valuation above $2.9B, including OpenAI-led financing.
startups.notes: Round aggregates per Sacra; official tranche breakdown not fully public.

startups.about: AI defense technology: autonomous aircraft, drones, and command systems
startups.description: Anduril builds AI-powered defense systems including autonomous aircraft, counter-drone systems, and the Lattice command platform. It closed a $5B Series H at a $61B valuation in May 2026, led by Thrive Capital and a16z — doubling in a year — and was reported in July 2026 to be in talks for a round near $100B.
startups.notes: Jul 2026: Reuters reported talks valuing the company at ~$100B.

startups.about: Autonomous vehicle & defense simulation and ADAS tooling
startups.description: Applied Intuition provides simulation, perception testing, and ADAS tooling to automakers and defense programs. It closed a $600M Series F plus tender at a $15B valuation in June 2025, co-led by BlackRock and Kleiner Perkins — nearly double its prior $8B mark — with total funding around $1.2–1.5B.

startups.about: Apollo humanoid robots for logistics and industry
startups.description: Apptronik, spun out of UT Austin, builds the Apollo humanoid robot targeting warehouse and manufacturing work, with partnerships including Mercedes-Benz and GXO. It announced a $520M Series A-X in February 2026 — with Google participation — at a reported $5B valuation, bringing total Series A financing to $935M+.

startups.about: Autonomous trucking (Aurora Driver); NASDAQ-listed
startups.description: Aurora Innovation commercialized self-driving trucking with driverless commercial routes in Texas since 2025 and is listed on NASDAQ (AUR) since its 2021 SPAC merger. It is included here as a public-company reference for autonomous-vehicle tracking; its market cap fluctuates with AUR shares.
startups.status_note: Publicly traded on NASDAQ (AUR) since November 2021.

startups.about: Low-cost hypersonic and strike missiles built on automotive methods
startups.description: Castelion, founded by former SpaceX executives, designs affordable hypersonic strike missiles using automotive-style production. It raised a $1B Series C at a $13B valuation in August 2026 — $800M equity plus $250M credit — quadrupling its valuation from ~$3.4B earlier in the year.

startups.about: Humanoid robots (Figure 02/03) for labor deployment
startups.description: Figure AI develops general-purpose humanoid robots and has begun commercial deployments targeting logistics and manufacturing labor. Its Series C exceeded $1B in committed capital at a $39B post-money valuation in September 2025 — making it the most valuable US robotics startup — and it is scaling production via its BotQ facility.
startups.source: Figure AI (official), The Robot Report, Reuters

startups.about: General intelligence for the physical world (robot foundation models)
startups.description: Generalist AI is a frontier research and product company training robot foundation models for real-world labor. It announced $400M in new funding in June 2026 — taking total raised past half a billion — and quietly raised roughly $200M more within two months per Axios in August 2026.

startups.about: AI-guided precision manufacturing for defense and aerospace
startups.description: Hadrian automates precision parts manufacturing for defense and aerospace primes using AI-guided CNC factories in California and Arizona. It raised a fresh $1.37B round at a $7.87B valuation in August 2026 — a 5x step-up from January 2026 — with a mile-long investor list per TechCrunch.

startups.about: Europe's leading defense AI: autonomy software and drones
startups.description: Helsing builds AI for defense — autonomy software, EW, and strike drones — for European militaries and Ukraine. It raised a record $1.8B Series E in July 2026 at an $18B valuation, co-led by Dragoneer, the largest defense-tech round in European history; total funding is ~$3.4B.

startups.about: Autonomous driving AI licensing platform
startups.description: Nuro pivoted from delivery robots to licensing its Level 4 autonomous driving stack to automakers, with partnerships including Lucid and Uber. It closed a $203M Series E at a $6B valuation in August 2025, with Uber, Baillie Gifford, and Nvidia participating; total funding exceeds $2.3B.

startups.about: General-purpose robot foundation models (π0 family)
startups.description: Physical Intelligence trains generalist foundation models that give robots dexterous manipulation skills across hardware platforms. Its $600M Series B closed in November 2025 at a $5.6B valuation, bringing total funding to ~$1.1B; Bloomberg reported talks in March 2026 for ~$1B more at roughly $11B, not yet confirmed closed.
startups.notes: Mar 2026: reported talks at ~$11B valuation (Bloomberg); last confirmed round Nov 2025.

startups.about: Autonomous surface vessels and the Port Alpha shipyard
startups.description: Saronic builds autonomous surface vessels for naval operations and is developing Port Alpha, a $3.2B autonomous shipyard in Brownsville, Texas. It closed a $1.75B Series D at a $9.25B valuation on March 31, 2026, led by Kleiner Perkins — more than doubling its $4B mark from early 2025.

startups.about: Low-cost modular AI drones for defense missions (YC W26)
startups.description: Seeing Systems, founded by Matthew and Alexander Le Maitre in London, builds low-cost modular drones that fly complex missions with minimal human input for defense customers. It emerged from Y Combinator's W26 batch and raised an early round of roughly $5M with Pioneer Fund participating.

startups.about: Hivemind AI pilot for autonomous jets and drones
startups.description: Shield AI develops Hivemind, an AI pilot enabling autonomous operation of jets, drones, and loitering munitions without GPS or comms. It announced a $1.5B Series G at a $12.7B post-money valuation plus $500M in fixed-income financing in March 2026 — a 140% valuation jump in one year.

startups.about: General-purpose foundation model for robotics (Skild Brain)
startups.description: Skild AI builds a general-purpose 'robot brain' — a foundation model that adapts to any robot form factor and task. SoftBank led its $1.4B Series C in January 2026, tripling its valuation to over $14B in seven months; total funding now exceeds $2B across four rounds.

startups.about: Autonomous sidewalk delivery robots at scale
startups.description: Starship Technologies operates the world's largest fleet of autonomous sidewalk delivery robots, founded by Skype co-founders Ahti Heinla and Janus Friis. It raised a $50M Series C in October 2025, bringing total funding to ~$316M as it expands across US, UK, and European campuses and cities.

startups.about: Agentic AI security operations platform (SOC agents)
startups.description: 7AI deploys swarms of autonomous AI agents for security operations, automating alert enrichment, investigation, and response for enterprises. It launched with a $36M seed (Feb 2025) and closed a $130M Series A in December 2025 — an unusually large early-stage round reported by WSJ — bringing total funding to $166M.
startups.notes: Fast Company Most Innovative Companies 2026, #6 in Security.

startups.about: AI-native behavioral email & human risk security
startups.description: Abnormal AI stops socially engineered email attacks and account takeover by modeling human behavior rather than signatures. Its $250M Series D at a $5.1B valuation (Aug 2024) remains the last priced round; the company, formerly Abnormal Security, continues to expand into human-risk management.

startups.about: AI-powered security awareness training & human risk management
startups.description: Adaptive Security simulates AI-driven attacks (including deepfake phishing) and delivers personalized security training to reduce human risk. It closed an $81M Series B in December 2025 with NVIDIA, Bain Capital Ventures, Capital One Ventures, and Citi Ventures participating, bringing total funding to $146.5M.
startups.notes: Original repo entry claimed '~$9B valuation' — unsupported by sources; removed.

startups.about: Data security posture management — the trust layer for enterprise AI
startups.description: Cyera provides AI-native data security and governance, discovering and protecting sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, and AI systems. It raised $600M at a $12B valuation in June 2026, a late-stage round that tripled its January 2026 $9B mark; total funding exceeds $1.8B.

startups.about: AI-native defense against social engineering and brand impersonation
startups.description: Doppel detects and takes down phishing, fake domains, and brand impersonation across domains, social media, and marketplaces in real time. It closed a $70M Series C in December 2025 with American Express Ventures joining, led by Google Ventures (GV), following a $35M Series B in June 2025.
startups.notes: Series C announced Dec 2025; valuation figure unconfirmed.

startups.about: Cloud & AI security platform; acquired by Google for $32B
startups.description: Wiz built the fastest-scaling security platform in history — agentless cloud and AI security across AWS, Azure, and GCP — reaching $700M ARR. Google completed its $32B acquisition on March 11, 2026, its largest deal ever, roughly one year after announcing intent. Wiz operates within Google Cloud as a standalone product.
startups.source: Google Cloud Press, CRN, PR Newswire

startups.about: AI study notes, flashcards & quizzes from any lecture or document
startups.description: Coconote turns lectures, PDFs, and videos into structured notes, flashcards, and quizzes, popular among university students. It is Y Combinator-backed; Tracxn reports no institutional funding round as of August 2026, so funding remains undisclosed/pre-seed.
startups.notes: Original repo listed it as 'by Quizlet' — incorrect; removed.

startups.about: AI-first language and learning platform; NASDAQ-listed
startups.description: Duolingo is the world's most popular learning app, with 500M+ registered users and AI-generated lessons via its Birdbrain system. Publicly traded on NASDAQ (DUOL) since July 2021 — included as a public-company reference for AI-native consumer education tracking.
startups.status_note: Publicly traded on NASDAQ (DUOL) since July 2021.

startups.about: AI assistant platform for teachers and schools
startups.description: MagicSchool provides AI tools for lesson planning, assessment, and differentiated instruction used by millions of educators. It raised a $45M Series B in February 2025 led by Valor Equity Partners with Adobe participating; total funding is ~$65M.

startups.about: AI corporate learning & knowledge platform; acquired by Workday
startups.description: Sana built an AI-powered corporate learning and knowledge platform with adaptive courses and an AI tutor, raising ~$138M including a $55M round led by NEA. Workday signed a definitive agreement to acquire the company for approximately $1.1B in September 2025 — its largest deal ever — and completed the acquisition shortly after.
